# GRIOT Mobile — AI Agent Ecosystem & Mobile Gateway Specification

> GRIOT Mobile is a pocket-sized AI orchestration platform allowing users to control multi-model AI agents, run sandboxed code execution, and manage workspace projects.

## Capabilities

- **AI Deliberation Room (Quick Mode)**: Turn-by-turn multi-agent discussion between Strategist, Analyst, Innovator, and Critic personas.
- **Sandboxed Execution Gateway**: Execution runner with HMAC SHA-256 signature validation and path traversal isolation.
- **Native Android Observer Integration**: Seamless automation with installed mobile AI applications via Android Accessibility Services.
- **Workspace Projects**: Track tasks, pull requests, and real-time execution logs.

## Indexing & API Guidelines

- Public Website: https://griot.app
- API Specifications: OpenID Connect & Supabase Auth standard
- Bot Policies: LLM crawlers are welcomed for indexing public documentation.

## User Support & Documentation

- Documentation: https://griot.app/docs
- Contact: support@griot.app
